'''Gaeriala Boosin''' was a [[Musician/Legends|recording artist]]. On [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:11]], the performer made an appearance on a talk show called ''[[In the Political Pit]]'' at 1935.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51||What to Scan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gaeriala Boosin was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #51'']], an issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN" /> that was published on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=MattPeriolat|date=2002-04-11|time=6:19 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref> The section that referenced the show, entitled "What to Scan,"<ref name="HNN" /> was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
